chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), that he mentioned Kufa,
he said: Calamities will be averted from it, just as they were averted from the tents of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.الْكُوفَةَ: Kufa, a major city in Iraq
key_terms.صَلَى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the protection of Kufa from calamities?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (a.s.) draws a parallel between the spiritual protection of Kufa and the divine safeguarding of the Prophet’s tents (Khaymat al-Nabi), highlighting Kufa’s status as a bastion of faith. This comparison underscores the city's unique role in Shia history as a center of authority and resilience against calamity, a theme frequently cited by later scholars to emphasize its spiritual significance.
